project_type: Laravel 12 full-stack MVC application with Blade + TailwindCSS + Alpine.js
test_framework: PHPUnit 11 (no tests required for this greenfield MVP)
build_command: php -l on all PHP files to validate syntax
verification_instructions: 1. Run php -l on all PHP files to validate syntax. 2. Verify all referenced classes exist. 3. Verify route file consistency with controllers.
setup_instructions: 1. composer install 2. npm install 3. cp .env.example .env 4. php artisan key:generate 5. Create MySQL database 6. php artisan migrate --seed 7. npm run build 8. php artisan serve
environment_constraints: No composer/npm available in sandbox. Validation via php -l syntax checks only. No MySQL server available. Target is local dev machine.
contribution_requirements: All code must be syntactically valid PHP. Method names must be consistent between services and controllers. DashboardService uses getDonneesDashboard(). MySQL as default DB. R2 Cloudflare for image storage.
key_patterns: Controller -> Service -> Repository -> Model architecture. French naming for domain concepts. Enums for status/type. Events/Listeners for side effects. Form Requests for validation. Blade components for UI.
relevant_files: All files - greenfield generation from existing reference codebase at /projects/sandbox/atelier-couture/
directory_structure: Standard Laravel 12 structure: app/ (Enums, Events, Exceptions, Http, Listeners, Models, Policies, Providers, Repositories, Services), bootstrap/, config/, database/ (factories, migrations, seeders), public/, resources/ (css, js, views), routes/, storage/
